about_short_description.short_description: Poggio Labs develops customer data applications.

product.name: Poggio Revenue AI Superagent
product.description: An AI-powered revenue intelligence application that combines CRM, conversation, and external data to help revenue teams understand accounts, prioritize opportunities, and execute account strategies.

product.name: Poggio for Salesforce
product.description: A Salesforce-integrated revenue intelligence product that adds continuously updated customer context, account plans, points of view, and recommended actions to the CRM.

product.name: Poggio for Slack
product.description: A Slack-based interface for accessing Poggio’s revenue intelligence, querying connected business data, researching contacts, and creating or reviewing account plans.

product.name: Poggio for Agents
product.description: An offering that extends Poggio’s revenue intelligence and account-planning capabilities to AI agents, enabling agents to access customer context and help execute revenue workflows.

product.name: Poggio Platform
product.description: The underlying data and integration platform that unifies CRM, conversation, web, database, API, and MCP sources to deliver revenue intelligence across Salesforce, Slack, and agent workflows.
